Roblox Game Design Document
Game Title
Pet Factory Tycoon
Genre
Tycoon
Simulator
Collecting
Trading
Rebirth
Core Idea
Players start with a small pet factory that creates cute pets. They earn Coins by producing pets, unlock better machines, discover rare pets, rebirth for permanent bonuses, complete quests, and trade with friends.
The gameplay should be easy to understand within 30 seconds.
Gameplay Loop:
Collect Coins → Upgrade Factory → Unlock Better Pets → Sell Pets → Buy More Machines → Rebirth → Unlock New Worlds → Repeat
World Design
Spawn Area
Contains:
Tutorial NPC
Daily Reward
Shop

Trading Plaza
Leaderboards

Worlds
Grassland
Desert
Snow

Secret Dimension
Each world has:
Better pets
Better machines
New quests
Better rewards
Currency
Coins Main currency.
Gems Premium currency earned through quests.
Tokens Earned from rebirths.
Event Currency Limited-time events only.
Factory System
Players own:
Conveyor belts
Pet incubators
Storage
Upgrade station
Auto collectors
Machines automatically create pets.
Higher tier machines produce better pets.
Pet System
Pet rarities:
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Mythic
Divine
Secret
Each pet gives multipliers.
Example:
Cat = x1
Dog = x2
Dragon = x10
Galaxy Phoenix = x100
Void God = x500
Egg System
Players spend coins to hatch pets.
Eggs:
Starter Egg
Forest Egg
Ice Egg
Lava Egg
Galaxy Egg
Mythic Egg
Secret Egg
Animations should be satisfying.
Upgrades
Upgrade:

Pet value
Storage
Walk speed
Luck
Critical chance
Offline earnings
Auto selling
Rebirth System
Requirements:
Reach a coin goal.
Rebirth rewards:
Permanent multiplier
Luck bonus
New worlds
Tokens
Special cosmetics
Quests
Daily
Weekly
Achievements
Examples:
Collect 500 pets
Open 50 eggs
Play 30 minutes
Rebirth twice
Trade once
Rewards:
Coins
Gems
Boosts
Exclusive pets
Trading
Safe trade system.
Players can trade:
Pets
Boosts
Limited items
Require both players to confirm.
Friends Bonus
Playing with friends:
+10% Coins
+10% Luck
Encourages players to invite others.

Monetization (Gamepasses)
Keep purchases optional and avoid making the game "pay to win." Focus on convenience, cosmetics, and time-saving features so free players can still enjoy the game.
Starter Pack (199 Robux)
Exclusive pet
Small coin boost
Cosmetic title
VIP (399 Robux)
Gold chat tag
Exclusive trail
Daily VIP chest
Small permanent bonus
VIP lounge
Auto Hatch (299 Robux)
Automatically hatch eggs.
Triple Hatch (499 Robux)
Hatch three eggs at once.
Fast Hatch (399 Robux)
Faster hatch animations.
Extra Pet Slots (249 Robux)
Equip more pets.
Bigger Storage (199 Robux)
More inventory space.
Auto Collect (299 Robux)
Automatically collect factory output.
Rainbow Name Tag (149 Robux)
Cosmetic only.
Special Effects Pack (99 Robux)
Unique trails and particle effects.
Developer Products
Offer optional consumables players can buy repeatedly:
Coin packs
Gem packs
15-minute Coin Boost
15-minute Luck Boost
Exclusive limited egg
Event currency bundle
Retention Features
Daily rewards
Quests
Rebirth system
Trading
Limited events
Leaderboards
Weekly updates
Seasonal content
UI
Main buttons:
Pets
Shop
Worlds
Rebirth
Quests
Trading
Settings
Gamepasses
Daily Rewards
Mobile-friendly layout with large buttons.
Sound & Visual Style
Style:
Bright
Colorful
Cute
Cartoon-like
Effects:
Coin pop-ups
Sparkles
Confetti for rare pets
Satisfying hatch animations
Reward sounds
Systems to Build (Development Order)
Player data saving (DataStore)
Currency system
Factory production system
Inventory system
Pet system
Egg hatching
Shop
Upgrade system
Rebirth system
World teleporting
Quests
Daily rewards
Trading
Leaderboards
Gamepasses
Developer products
Events
Polish, optimization, and bug fixes
Long-Term Updates
New worlds every month
New pets every week
Seasonal events
Limited collectibles
Trading improvements
Community challenges
Achievement expansions
New factory machines
This design emphasizes a straightforward gameplay loop, progression, and social features that can encourage players to return. The monetization focuses on optional convenience and cosmetic purchases, which tends to create a healthier player experience while still giving players reasons to support the game.

answers.ask: How big is one player's factory plot, and how many plots per server?
answers.answer: Use a compact factory plot sized for a small starter conveyor setup with room to expand through upgrades, and support 8 plots per server. Keep the layout easy to read and mobile-friendly.

answers.ask: Are the ten worlds separate maps you teleport to, or districts of one map?
answers.answer: The ten worlds are separate maps accessed through teleport portals, as indicated by the Spawn Area teleport portal and world progression.

answers.ask: Should all ten worlds share the cartoon look, or does each get its own treatment?
answers.answer: All worlds should keep the bright, colorful, cute cartoon-like visual style, while using their named environments—Desert, Snow, Space, and so on—for distinct scenery.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How big is one player's factory plot, and how many plots per server? A: Use a compact factory plot sized for a small starter conveyor setup with room to expand through upgrades, and support 8 plots per server. Keep the layout easy to read and mobile-friendly.
- [author] shape — Q: Are the ten worlds separate maps you teleport to, or districts of one map? A: The ten worlds are separate maps accessed through teleport portals, as indicated by the Spawn Area teleport portal and world progression.
- [author] theme — Q: Should all ten worlds share the cartoon look, or does each get its own treatment? A: All worlds should keep the bright, colorful, cute cartoon-like visual style, while using their named environments—Desert, Snow, Space, and so on—for distinct scenery.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a bright, colorful, cute cartoon pet-factory tycoon hub with exactly eight compact personal factory plots arranged around a readable Spawn Area. Give every plot one small starter conveyor line with pet incubator, storage, upgrade station, auto collector, and clearly reserved expansion ground. In the Spawn Area, include a tutorial NPC, daily-reward station, shop, gamepass shop, trading plaza, physical leaderboards, VIP lounge, and ten clearly marked world portals. Build ten separate small world maps—Grassland, Desert, Snow, Volcano, Space, Cyber City, Fantasy, Heaven, Void, and Secret Dimension—each retaining the same cute cartoon style while using distinct named scenery, better pet and machine areas, quest stations, one portal arrival, and one return portal. Keep portal labels and destinations visually unambiguous.

## Genre
Simulation is the dominant genre.

## Shape and preset
Use `hub-portals`, Portal Hub, because one main factory-and-spawn map feeds ten separate worlds. Apply the Tycoon preset to the eight-plot factory portion, substituting `plot-isolated` for its shared-plot shape.

## Config requirements
Use `social-hub` for the Spawn Area and Trading Plaza, `path-circulation` for links to eight plots and ten portals, `teleporter-link` for separate-map world travel, `gate-progression` for factory expansion and locked worlds, and `building-interior` for the shop and VIP lounge. Use `terrain-relief` in Volcano. Each plot directly includes conveyors, incubator, storage, collector, and upgrade geometry.

## Layout requirements
For `teleporter-link`, place ten departure portals in the Spawn Area and an arrival/return pair in each world. Use `trigger-task` for eight plot collectors, eight upgrade stations, eight incubators, the daily-reward station, and world quest stations. Use `npc-population` for one tutorial NPC. Use `tracker-leaderboard` for one physical board with panels for Coins, Rebirths, Play Time, Rare Pets, and Top Traders.

## Layout components
The Main Hub map contains the Spawn Area and eight non-overlapping `plot-isolated` factory plots. Grassland, Desert, Snow, Volcano, Space, Cyber City, Fantasy, Heaven, Void, and Secret Dimension are ten separate `space-bounded` maps with distinct scenery and return points. Every factory plot begins compact and retains visible expansion space. Paths remain broad and mobile-readable.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: eight-plot balance, Spawn Area circulation, and ten portal destinations must be authoritative before the cartoon dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium per map, driven by readable machines within compact factory plots. The theme is consistently bright, colorful, cute cartoon, with environment-specific variations. Use `P4` for ten separate worlds, `P3` for the shop and VIP lounge interiors, and `tiered` for Volcano relief.

Broad, mobile-readable circulation paths linking the Spawn Area to the eight factory plots and to the ten world portals.
Ten clearly marked world teleport portals in the Spawn Area, plus in each world one portal arrival and one return portal back to the hub, with labels and destinations visually unambiguous.
Factory expansion gates within each plot and locked worlds / world progression gates controlling access to later worlds.
Enterable shop and an enterable VIP lounge.
Terrain relief focused in the Volcano world map (tiered volcanic elevation).
Interactable task stations for: eight plot collectors, eight upgrade stations, eight incubators, the daily-reward station, and quest stations in each world.
One tutorial NPC in the Spawn Area.
One physical leaderboard board with panels for Coins, Rebirths, Play Time, Rare Pets, and Top Traders.
